transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I keep going dizzy when I stand up.
Could you tell me when you first noticed this dizziness when standing up, how it came on, whether anything seemed to set it off, and if you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
It started about ten days ago.
Could you tell me how bad the dizziness is or how much it affects your daily life, and about any medicines you take regularly or have started or changed recently, including doses if you know them?
I nearly fell and grabbed the kitchen worktop.
Can you tell me a bit about your health in the past — any long-term conditions, past illnesses, operations, or hospital stays?
I've had high blood pressure about fifteen years.
Do you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines, do you have no known allergies, or are you not sure?
No, I don't have any allergies.
When you feel dizzy standing up, what else, if anything, do you notice at the same time?
No, no chest pain or that.
At the moment, are you taking any medicines — none at all, one or more, or you're not sure?
I started a new blood pressure tablet.
Where in your body do you feel the dizzy feeling?
It's a swimmy feeling, like I might faint.
How often does this dizzy feeling happen when you stand up?
Several times a day.
When that swimmy feeling comes on, does it stay in one spot, move around or spread to other parts of your body, or you're not sure?
It's not in one spot, it's all over.
What worries you most about this swimmy feeling when you stand up?
I think the new tablet's causing it.
Besides your high blood pressure, is there anything else from your past health—like other long-term conditions, past illnesses, operations, or hospital stays—that you’d like to add?
I've got arthritis in both hips.
Has the dizzy feeling when you stand up changed how you do your usual daily activities?
I've stopped going to my Tuesday lunch club.
When you get that dizzy feeling standing up, is there anything else you notice happening at the same time?
My daughter pops round to see me each week.

Besides your high blood pressure and arthritis in both hips, is there anything else from your past health—like other long-term conditions, past illnesses, operations, or hospital stays—that you’d like to add?
No, nothing else I can think of.
Is there anything else you notice when the dizzy feeling comes on?
No blackouts or weakness in my arms or legs.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
